# technitium_settings_ldap (Resource)

Manages LDAP authentication: users from an LDAP directory, such as Active Directory or OpenLDAP, signing in with their directory credentials, and how directory groups map to local groups. Destroying the resource leaves the configuration as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "ldap_bind_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "technitium_group" "dns_administrators" {
  name = "DNS Administrators"
}

resource "technitium_settings_ldap" "this" {
  enabled            = true
  server             = "dc01.example.com"
  port               = 636
  ssl_option         = "LDAPS"
  bind_username      = "CN=svcDNS,OU=ServiceAccounts,DC=example,DC=com"
  bind_password      = var.ldap_bind_password
  search_base        = "DC=example,DC=com"
  user_search_filter = "(sAMAccountName={0})"
  group_attribute    = "memberOf"
  allow_signup       = true

  group_map = [
    { remote_group = "CN=DNS Admins,OU=Groups,DC=example,DC=com", local_group = data.technitium_group.dns_administrators.name },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_signup` (Boolean) Create an account for a directory user the first time they sign in.
- `allow_signup_only_for_mapped_users` (Boolean) Let a new user sign up only when they are in at least one directory group in `group_map`.
- `bind_password` (String, Sensitive) The service account's password. The server never returns it, so a password changed outside Terraform is not detected.
- `bind_username` (String) The distinguished name or user principal name of the service account that searches the directory. Leave it out to bind anonymously.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Allow signing in with LDAP.
- `group_attribute` (String) The user attribute that lists their groups, for example `memberOf`.
- `group_map` (Attributes Set) Maps directory groups to local groups. An LDAP user's local groups are synced from it each time they sign in. An empty set removes the map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_map))
- `ignore_ssl_errors` (Boolean) Accept the server's TLS certificate even when it does not validate.
- `port` (Number) The LDAP port. Usually `389` for plain LDAP and StartTLS, `636` for LDAPS. Technitium's default is `389`.
- `search_base` (String) The distinguished name to search for users under, for example `DC=example,DC=com`.
- `server` (String) The domain name or IP address of the LDAP server.
- `ssl_option` (String) How the connection is secured: `None`, `StartTLS` or `LDAPS`.
- `user_search_filter` (String) The filter that finds a user, with `{0}` for the username: `(sAMAccountName={0})` for Active Directory, `(uid={0})` for OpenLDAP.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--group_map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_map`

Required:

- `local_group` (String) The local group its members join.
- `remote_group` (String) The directory group, as `group_attribute` lists it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_settings_ldap.this settings_ldap
```
